enforcement.scope: adopted detectable rules; semantic composition and test quality require review

readiness.revisionLabelIsActual: The scaffold runs outside Git, so its measured identity is unversioned plus exact source digest. The checkout merge/head are recorded separately; no SHA prefix is invented.

checks.observation: Running backend health and web identify this revision and local proof environment.
Creating through the web is visible in a fresh authenticated Convex read.
Web done/reopen actions survive independent reads; MCP observes reopened status, and MCP done survives a web reload.
Another signed user cannot read or mutate the first user’s item through Convex or MCP.
MCP denies anonymous, web-audience, wrong-audience and expired credentials; Convex denies anonymous/wrong-audience reads.
Malformed status arguments are rejected and the UI resource contains its required JS/CSS.
The MCP resource applies initial and updated host styles, acknowledges teardown, remounts, and changes persisted status through AppBridge and web reloads.
No uncaught web JavaScript error was observed during the create/reload journey.
Disposable issuer verifies auth boundaries. Live WorkOS sign-in, refresh and organization lifecycle require a configured test tenant.
Local AppBridge host was exercised. Installed ChatGPT OAuth, tool selection and UI behavior were not run.

evidence.transformationPolicy: Only known filesystem user/runner and randomized temporary prefixes replaced in UTF-8 exported copies. Existing terminal bytes and all other content remain unchanged. Original files remain local and untouched; PNGs are byte-exact.
evidence.scanLimit: Pattern observations are bounded; they do not guarantee detecting every possible secret. Two PNGs were visually checked for synthetic test data.
evidence.archiveVerification: Two stored-byte builds with sorted paths, fixed timestamps and permissions matched. Every entry matched its retained hash; source hashes were rechecked unchanged.
